title: A rapid stress signal
hook: Connect a hormonal signal with a target.

knows: Hormones can carry signals through the blood to target tissues.
doesNotKnow: The adrenal medulla releases epinephrine, which can increase heart rate as part of a sympathetic response.

misconception: All hormones come from one gland and act on every cell.
objective: Identify the stated endocrine signal and its target in a simplified pathway.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which adrenal-medulla hormone can increase heart rate during a sympathetic response? The adrenal medulla releases epinephrine, which can increase heart rate as part of a sympathetic response.
The diagram shows one selected source–target pathway, not all hormone effects or feedback loops.
Recall: In the stated example, which source releases Epinephrine into the circulation? The adrenal medulla releases epinephrine, which can increase heart rate as part of a sympathetic response.

recall.question: In the stated example, which source releases Epinephrine into the circulation?
recall.why: The adrenal medulla releases epinephrine, which can increase heart rate as part of a sympathetic response.
